sources.quote: No reward points will be provided for transactions falling under the Fuel category.

sources.doc: ICICI Credit Card MITC (reward points capping)
sources.quote: Reward Points accrued per statement cycle will be capped for certain MCCs
Earn Points on every Rs 100 spend: 4 On Domestic Spend, 4 On International Spend, 1 On Utility and Insurance Spend

examples.title: Rs 10,000 domestic retail spend
examples.why: 4 reward points per Rs 100 on eligible retail spends: 100 x 4 = 400.

examples.title: Rs 10,000 international spend
examples.why: 4 reward points per Rs 100 on international spends too: 100 x 4 = 400.

examples.title: Rs 20,000 grocery spend
examples.why: Grocery and departmental stores earn the standard 4 per Rs 100, up to Rs 40,000 of spend per statement cycle: 200 x 4 = 800.

examples.title: Rs 10,000 electricity bill
examples.why: Utility spend earns 1 point per Rs 100 (ICICI product page) and counts to the Rs 80,000 per statement cycle utility limit.

examples.title: Rs 5,000 on a taxi/metro MCC 4111
examples.why: Transportation MCCs (4111, 4112, 4784, 4131) earn 4 per Rs 100 until Rs 20,000 spend per statement cycle (from 1 Feb 2026): 50 x 4 = 200.

examples.title: Rs 10,000 grocery reaching the Rs 40,000 limit exactly
examples.why: Rs 30,000 of the Rs 40,000 grocery limit is used; Rs 10,000 more earns 100 x 4 = 400 and fills the limit.

examples.title: Rs 5,000 grocery after the limit is used
examples.why: Reward points are capped for grocery and departmental spend beyond Rs 40,000 per statement cycle: no points.

examples.title: Rs 3,000 fuel
examples.why: MITC: no reward points for the Fuel category (Emeralde is not an exception).

examples.title: Rs 25,000 rent payment
examples.why: MITC: no reward points for Cash and Rent categories.

examples.title: Rs 5,000 quasi-cash MCC 6051
examples.why: MITC: no reward points for the Cash category; the MITC MCC table lists Cash as 6011, 6050, 6051, 6529, 6530, 6538, 6666, 7777, 9999, 6010, 3882, 6541, 6542.

examples.title: Rs 20,000 rent at MCC 7014 not labelled rent
examples.why: MITC: no reward points for the Rent category; the MITC MCC table lists Rent as 7014, 7407, 5271, 6513.
